description: This file defines a React component `GuardrailViewer` and related subcomponents for displaying detailed guardrail analysis data, including visual status indicators, entity details, and responses from different guardrail providers.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp (in seconds) into a locale-specific string.

methods.name: GuardrailDetails
methods.description: A React component that displays detailed information about a single guardrail entry, including status, timing, masked entities, and provider-specific details.

methods.name: GuardrailViewer
methods.description: Main React component that manages and displays a list of guardrail entries with toggleable sections and summary status.
